描述_EN: the pattern of the silk consist of palmette or lotus design with the stylized chinese character shou, meaning longevity. as the fragment was found in an egyptian burial, it shows the far-reaching trade of chinese silk. this fragment is part of a group of chinese silks in the v&a collection, broadly dated between the late thirteenth century and the mid-fifteenth century, and supposedly were found in egypt. the one shown here, in blue damask, appears to be a section of a garment, presumably the side seam with a gore insertation, maybe part of a sleeve.
描述_ZN: 丝绸的图案由棕榈或莲花图案组成，上面有中国文字 "寿 "的字样，意为长寿。 由于该碎片是在埃及的墓葬中发现的，它显示了中国丝绸贸易的广泛性。 这块碎片是V&A收藏的一组中国丝绸的一部分，时间大致在13世纪末到15世纪中叶，据说是在埃及发现的。 这里显示的是蓝色锦缎，似乎是一件衣服的一部分，大概是侧缝，有一个孔的插入，也许是袖子的一部分。
